items.summary: Incident INC-32893D groups 51 methane plume detection(s) on 28 distinct dates between 2019-10-18 and 2026-03-09 at a location the provider attributes to oil & gas. The provider's median instantaneous emission estimate is 1,404 kg/h across 40 quantified detection(s). Carbon Mapper reports detections on 78% of observed overpass dates for the matching source grouping. The investigation priority is 81.4/100; the operator, facility and emitting component are not identified by these data.
